Variants.Content: The Arbor is located in the southwest sea of ​​the Reach. It is the ancestral home of the Redwyne family and the most famous wine-producing area in Westeros. The island's harbors and vineyards support a large merchant fleet and warship force; it belongs to the feudal system of Highgarden, but has independent weight with its fleet, golden wine and ocean trade.

A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.
